package loadtest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	generated "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest/protocol"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/action"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/protocol"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/scenario"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/session"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

// Step 的请求来自业务视图。配置只描述动作，不提供玩家身份、服务器时间或玩法配置。
type Step struct {
	Request   pb.PlayRequest
	WantCode  int32
	Reconnect bool
}

// Commands 共用公共 Robot，既可运行验收动作，也可由业务组装持续前进的负载序列。
// 重连后是否需要获取新业务 Epoch 取决于宿主接线，不能盲重放旧代的新写。
func Commands(cfg runner.Config, auth robot.AuthProvider, steps []Step) *runner.Runner {
	protocols := protocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	generated.RegisterDefaults(protocols)
	actions := action.NewRegistry()
	scenarios := scenario.NewRegistry()
	// 复制配置；多个机器人只读同一组请求，响应不能写回输入。
	steps = append([]Step(nil), steps...)
	scenarios.MustRegister(scenario.New("commands", scenario.NodeFunc(func(ctx context.Context, rb *robot.Context) error {
		if len(steps) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("robot: at least one business step is required")
		}
		if err := rb.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for i, step := range steps {
			if step.Reconnect {
				if err := rb.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
			message, err := rb.Session().CallChecked(callCtx, msgid.MsgPlay, msgid.MsgPlay, &step.Request, func(m *session.Message) error {
				response, ok := m.Value.(*pb.PlayResponse)
				if !ok || response.Seq != step.Request.Seq {
					return fmt.Errorf("invalid business response")
				}
				if response.Code != 0 {
					return session.ErrRejected
				}
				return nil
			})
			cancel()
			if err != nil && !(step.WantCode != 0 && errors.Is(err, session.ErrRejected)) {
				return fmt.Errorf("step %d: %w", i, err)
			}
			response, ok := message.Value.(*pb.PlayResponse)
			if !ok || response.Code != step.WantCode || response.Seq != step.Request.Seq {
				return fmt.Errorf("step %d: unexpected response %#v", i, message.Value)
			}
		}
		return nil
	})))
	cfg.Scenario = "commands"
	cfg.Transport.Type = transport.PlayerTCPType
	return runner.New(cfg, runner.WithAuthProvider(auth), runner.WithProtocolRegistry(protocols), runner.WithActionRegistry(actions), runner.WithScenarioRegistry(scenarios))
}
